_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Yes xugador {player_id} en Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
El to símbolu ye '{symbol}'.
Tomes turns poniendo el to símbolu n'un tableru 5x5 pa formar una llinia de cuatro.
Les llinies pueden ser horizontales, verticales o diagonales.
Unvia la to movida usando el formatu '[4]' pa marcar la celda 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Esti formatu ye inválidu. Utilizar "[cell]" onde la celda ye 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: El númberu de celda inválidu: {cell}. Debe tar ente 0 y {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: El xugador {player_id} fixo un movimientu inválidu.

game_action.placed: El xugador {player_id} asitia el so símbolu ({symbol}) nel campu ({row}, {col}).
